scene: The common room of the Drowned Lantern, a smugglers' tavern on the harbour.

turns.utterance: I stand up and dance a jig, silently, then sit down again.
I ask the barkeep, "So, you think I could make a career of that?" referring to the jig I just performed.
I walk over to Marga and say, "You dropped your dagger. You need to be more careful. Is that how you lost your eye?"
It seems like the last message was cut off.  His mouth forms a silent what?

How do his eyes bore into mine if he only has one. Wouldn't be his eye? Anyway, I quickly poke the one-eyed Marga in his only good eye, temporarily blinding him, and then jump back to avoid his silent promise of retribution.
"Oh, my god!" I cry. "I'm so sorry, Marga. I thought I saw a spider! Are you okay?" I put my hands up in surrender, ready for anything.
I cry, "Oh my god! It's the spider! It's back!" and I stab marga in his only remaining eye with my hidden dagger.
